request.state:
Icelandic original: „Ég á frábærar minningar af langafa mínum í þessu húsi og útsýnið er frábært. Sérstaklega þegar það er blækyrrt“
English gloss: “I have wonderful memories of my grandfather in this house, and the view is excellent. Especially when it is misty.”

faithful.instructions: Is the English gloss a faithful translation of the Icelandic original, with no added or missing meaning?
